slides.text: Reuters reports **Ethiopia and Eritrea** have built up forces near their **border**; reports of skirmishes are **unconfirmed**.
The **Red Cross** warns the humanitarian situation in **Oromia** is worsening and says it cannot reach everyone in need.
A **US lawmaker** drafted bills offering **trade incentives** for **Ethiopia-Eritrea peace**, The Hill reports; texts are not public.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Reuters, Addis Standard via AllAfrica, The Hill · Nov 18-20, 2026
